DECLARE @Anul INT = '[TknParams:Anul]'; 
DECLARE @Luna INT = '[TknParams:Luna]'; 

WITH Zile AS ( SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(@Anul, @Luna, 1) AS Data 

UNION ALL 

SELECT DATEADD(DAY, 1, Data) FROM Zile 

WHERE MONTH(DATEADD(DAY, 1, Data)) = @Luna ) 

SELECT COUNT(*) AS ZileLucratoare
FROM Zile z
WHERE DATENAME(WEEKDAY, z.Data) NOT IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday')
  AND (NOT EXISTS 
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM app.ZiLibera zl
        WHERE zl.An = @Anul
          AND zl.Luna = @Luna
          AND zl.Zi = DAY(z.Data)
          
    )  and NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM app.ZiLiberaCCM zl
        WHERE zl.An = @Anul
          AND zl.Luna = @Luna
          AND zl.Zi = DAY(z.Data)
          )
          
          );
